description: Discovery for mURL domain channels: 'trending' (most active in the last N hours, default 24) / 'list' (paginated catalogue, status-filtered) / 'mine' (channels you DNS-verified). Returns domain, slug, status, branding, verified_at + (for trending) messages_in_window. For who's-on-now, follow up with mURL_presence on the slug.

action.description: 'trending' (default) = most active domain channels in the last N hours; 'list' = paginated catalogue filtered by status; 'mine' = channels you own (DNS-verified).

cursor.description: For action='list': pagination — pass previous response's next_cursor (created_at ISO).

hours.description: Trending window in hours. Default 24, max 168 (7d).

name: mURL_list_channels
